claim_map.assertion: For every natural n>2, finrank_Q W_n <= finrank_Q FreeLie_Q(e_3,e_5,...)_n, with the three rational solution equations and weights 3,5,7,... .
The formal Wn, Fn, equations, grading, quantifier n>2, and axiom closure have the claimed interpretation.
subclaims: finite dimensionality of both fixed-weight spaces
ordinary odd-generator weights rather than length
claim_map.proof: Two definitional equivalences plus human reading of printed definitions; the latter is not kernel-checked.

claim_map.assertion: The same inequality holds for all n>=0.
claim_map.proof: C_UB_GT2 and L_LOW_WEIGHTS; mixed formal and human-readable evidence, not all-weight Lean closure.

claim_map.assertion: W_0=W_1=W_2=0: no constants; degree-one pentagon residual -alpha*t12-beta*t34; degree-two three-term residual 3c[x,y].
claim_map.proof: Exhaustive ordinary-Lie spanning lists and independent braid abelianization coordinates.

claim_map.assertion: The ordinary free-Lie and braid lattices are torsion-free with compatible ordinary-Lie reductions and fixed-degree dimensions.
For rational solutions of weight n>2, [a,psi(b,a)]+[c,psi(b,c)]=0, c=-a-b, and partial_2 psi(a,-a)T=0 before reduction.
Intersection with the integral solution lattice reduces injectively, preserving rational dimension and the applicable equations; arbitrary modular lifting is not asserted.
subclaims: Z and Z_(2) lattice reductions agree by odd-denominator clearing

claim_map.assertion: Over F2, A=x^2,C=[x,y],B=y give an injective associative presentation, whose ordinary Lie subalgebra contains all original x,y Lie elements of weight>1.
At B-count r and weight n=2m+r>2, opposite count-monotone source orderings transfer the leading pentagon at symbolic length m+r, without target independence.
subclaims: source/target table correspondence and count annotations
termination and count monotonicity of both ordering procedures

claim_map.assertion: chi(A,C,B) -> chi(0,C,B) is injective on each relevant associated-graded rational-solution reduction for n>2.
subclaims: least-A coefficient elimination and reversal under the leading relation

claim_map.assertion: The vectors [B,[A,B]] and ABB+BAB+BBA have independent coefficient columns over F2 in basis ABB,BAB,BBA.
The three source actions delta^2, epsilon, delta epsilon+epsilon delta have the 21 displayed values on H,Ui,Uj,Uk,Vi,Vj,Vk over F2.
claim_map.proof: Independent derivation expansion in the free associative word algebra.

claim_map.assertion: The projected image lies in the ordinary free Lie algebra on g_k=ad_C^k B, k>=1, weight 2k+1 and length r; r=0 vanishes.
subclaims: antisymmetry/even-index restriction in the source proof
gap-monomial independence and ordinary-Lie retraction removing g_0

claim_map.assertion: Finite filtration, projection injectivity, the ordinary-Lie image restriction, and dimension comparison imply the n>2 bound.
claim_map.duplicate_endpoint: C_UB_GT2; this is its alternative detailed argument, not another upper-bound theorem

claim_map.assertion: An externally known free odd-generator subalgebra gives only the reverse dimension inequality.
The cited computation and known inclusions give the stated conjectural equality through weight 29, not universally.
